picks.title: Bot protection blocks Blend's AI shopping agent at 29 of 200 retailers
picks.rationale: New audit of 200 retailers: bot protection turned away Blend's AI shopping agent at 29 stores (20% of large retailers vs 2.5% of emerging ones) even where robots.txt allows AI crawlers, so merchants should check their WAF settings before agentic holiday traffic.
picks.excerpt: Large retailers refused the agent at a 20% rate, emerging ones at 2.5%, yet all 24 refusers with readable robots.txt allow AI crawlers. Who set those blocks?
